text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Let's go, Trainer! Transform!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Trans・form!!

"...At Biko Pegasus's request,
I decided to narrate a tokusatsu hero show for her."

text_block_list.name: Trainer
text_block_list.text: Justice Biko transforms into her GⅠ Form in a mere 42 seconds.

text_block_list.name: Trainer
text_block_list.text: Then let's take a look at that transformation process!

text_block_list.name: Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Firmly visualizing the image of sprinting across the turf,
she focused purely on heightening her desire to win. And then—

text_block_list.name: Mother Computer
text_block_list.text: Racing suit, transferring now!

text_block_list.name: Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Catching that signal, the mobile mothership Pegasus Bird
transfers the racing suit as digitized particles.

text_block_list.name: Trainer
text_block_list.text: And so, Justice Biko transforms into her GⅠ Form!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Justice Biko!!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Heheh, thanks, Trainer! Having you do the narration got me so hyped up!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I've gotta go in today with top motivation!
—This is my biggest match yet.
choice_data_list: Yeah, let's become a hero who won't lose to her!
Yeah, let's become a hero who won't lose to her!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
An invincible hero...
I wanna be one, I really do! But—

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
It won't be easy...
Her strength and popularity are both off the charts...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Alright, here comes the Bakushin cheer!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Here we go: Bakushin, Bakushin!
Baaakushin, baaakushin!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much!
Let's entertain everyone today as well with overwhelming speed!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Heaven creates no one above the Class Rep,
nor creates anyone below the Class Rep!
Oooohh.

I didn't quite get what she meant...
but right now, Sakura Bakushin O was truly overflowing with confidence.

"No one could contest her. No one could catch her.
She was truly at her absolute peak, and yet..."

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: To-o-oh!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Oh, Biko-san, I've been waiting for you!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Running with you today was what I was looking forward to most!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"Me too, Bakushin O-senpai!
To be honest, I—"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I'm still not as strong as Bakushin O-senpai.
I might not be as popular, either. But...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Even Carrotman, who everyone looks up to, was weak at first, but by steadily doing his best, he became a popular hero!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Gradually becoming a hero... I see, so that's what you want to emulate.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Whatever I lack, I'll squeeze every drop of power out of my body to make up for it.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
My body might be small, but my heart isn't!
I'll definitely make Bakushin O-senpai
gasp in amazement!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Ohh... Biko-san...
These straightforward feelings are...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"It almost feels nostalgic now.
Those days are long gone..."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Classmates and rivals I was facing for the first time.
All I wanted, more than anything, was to win...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I used to fiercely compete with comrades
whom I rarely get to meet in races anymore.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Very well, Biko-san.
Show me. Show me your passion!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I'll throw everything I've got,
every last bit of myself, right at it!

Biko Pegasus delivers a reckless body blow.
Sakura Bakushin O takes it head-on.

With this clash across generations, the venue's excitement reaches its peak.
The curtain rises on the showdown that will decide the future of the sprint division.
